blocks.title: guillotine-mini factory
blocks.text: Python execution-specs are authoritative: gas order, hardfork guards and error mapping must match them exactly. Zig, WASM and client-ts checks run incrementally through Smithers with a local-first cache synced to build.smithers.sh; benchmarks are exclusive and always explicit.
